sections.excerpt: Namespaces refer to obtaining certain information from some scope to display in localisation. For example, getting the name of a country, the surname of a character, the ID of a state, and etc. A namespace is marked with the square brackets on either side as in `my_localisation_key: "[GetDateText]"`
